column1: # Tetris Effect: Connected: Monstars and Resonair's game on Unreal Engine 4.27 (IoStore, MallocBinned3), SDK 13.3.2, NVN, Epic Online Services through the Redpoint EOS plugin; update 2.0.2.2 (v1310720) over the base game.
# Started from the NSP script's provisional profile (dm/games/profile_guess.py) and brought up on the Mac and the iPhone (README.md)

# Game name: only a label for profile listings and the Mac window title; the iOS app name is the game name in the base NSP, and the bundle ID comes from the base game title ID (build_ipa.sh / NSP script)
# 1.0.0 (v0) is registered for its rewriter cuts (patches.py); the tables are 2.0.2.2's
# load order as on Horizon: main, subsdk*, sdk (subsdk0 = NintendoSDK_movie)
# The game sets near-zero NVN depth (nvnDeviceSetDepthMode); the NSP script's heap check found it

# Unreal Engine 4.27: nninitStartup needs virtual address memory and reserves a 62 GB region for the engine. The rewriter's engine-wide rules cut the FMallocBinned3 constructor call (dm/tools/ue_malloc.py,
# hle_uemalloc.c) and give the region what the alias region has room for (dm/tools/ue_region.py, hle_svc.c); the SDK-wide rules cut the SDK's node area to 62 MB (dm/tools/sdk_patches.py).
# The layout of the other Unreal 4.27 games (Mario & Luigi: Brothership, OCTOPATH TRAVELER II); the provisional 64 GB alias region failed on the iPhone (FATAL reserve guest AS)
# the NPDM declares 80 MB of system resource
# Each material's shaders inline in its cooked package, the packages in the IoStore container (TetrisEffect-Switch.utoc), the global shaders in the pak: shader_split.py ue_legacy_jobs.
# The groups and the note are as the provisional profile wrote them (shader inputs)
